note: Cites 'die Urkunde vom 19. Juny d. J. bereits verliehenen Gütern: Betschen, Zagórów und Wienietz'. Dated 1 December 1797, so 'd. J.' is 1797.
'Cabinets Ordre überreichen wir ... abschriftlich anliegend': document 2 is that copy.
The King returns the case files 'mittelst Berichts vom 18ten v. M. ... eingesandten': sent in with the report of 18 June, of which this file holds the copy for the Grand Chancellor.
'in der Anlage eine Abschrift der Cabinets-Ordre vom 1ten ... hujus': document 4 is that copy.

Written to obey 'Euer Königlichen Majestät allerhöchstem Befehl vom 18 November ... nach welchem der Titulus possessionis über die Hochfürstlich Hohenlohischen Güter Kopojno, Zagórów, Drzewce, p. p. berichtiget werden soll'. Document 30 is that order, of 18 November 1800, over the same estates. Note that 29 is subscribed 'Breslau den 3ten Novbr 1800', which is BEFORE the order it answers: ruled by the editor, 2026-09-17, an error in the original document rather than a misreading, so the link stands and the date is left as written.
The Prince's covering letter to his petition of the same day: 'mein Bittschreiben noch mit diesen wenigen Worten zu begleiten'.
The decree on the Prince's petition, under the same journal number 5957; documents 8, 9 and 10 were written from it.
'Ew: Durchlauchten Wunsch, daß Hochdero Rechts-Sache ... nicht von der Regierung zu Posen abgeurtelt werde': the Prince's petition of 30 November.
'Ad Rescriptum clementissimum vom 7ten': the rescript of 7 December to the government at Poznań.
'es kann folglich das obangezogene Rescript keine Anwendung finden': the rescript of 7 December to the government at Warsaw.
Tells the Prince that the order announced on 7 December came too late for the first instance.

Attests that the Betsche estates were conferred 'durch die Schenkungs Urkunde von 10ten Juny 1797'. The day is written 10 here where every other copy in this holding reads the 19th. Ruled by the editor, 2026-09-17: an error in the original document, not a misreading, and left standing.
And by 'deren Deklarezion von des izt regierenden Königl. Majestaat vom 1ten December ejd: a.' - document 11.
Grants the appurtenances of 'den durch die Urkunde vom 19ten Juny bereits verliehenen Güthern: Betsche, Zagórów und Wienietz'. Document 10 is that grant of 19 June 1797.

The mortgage certificate enters the title 'auf den Grund der Verleihungs-Urkunden für den regierenden Herrn Fürsten Friedrich Ludwig zu Hohenlohe Ingelfingen dedato Berlin den 19ten Juny 1797 und de dato Berlin den 1ten Debr: ej. a.'
The second of the two grants that certificate enters the title under: 'de dato Berlin den 1ten Debr: ej. a.'
The Treasury's resignation is made 'auf den Grund der Verleihungs Urkunde Unsers in Gott ruhenden Herrn Vaters Königs Friedrich Wilhelm des zweiten Majestaet vom 19ten Juni 1797.'
And on 'Unserer Declaration derselben vom 1ten Debr.' - document 11, the supplementary grant of 1 December 1797.
The same supplementary grant, here citing 'die Urkund vom 19t Junius d. J. bereits verliehenen Güthern, Betsche, Zagórów und Wienietz'.
Cites 'die Urkunde vom 19ten Junius d J. bereits verliehenen Gütern, Betschen, Zagórów, und Wienietz'.
Document 16 records that the contract made over these ten Hufen on 26 May of that year by one Kunkel was handed back and wholly annulled. Document 17 is that Kunkel contract, dated 26 May 1804.
The contract calls Triebenfeld 'durch beiliegende Vollmacht legitimiert'; the court certified this copy of the power of attorney on 21 March 1806, the day it engrossed the contract.
Triebenfeld acknowledges 'das unterm 28. Januar a. c. ausgestellte Obligations- und respective Cessions-Instrument' a second time, before the court at Kalisz.

Document 21 is conditional throughout on the sale to Honrichs having been annulled; document 2 is the purchase punctation to Martin Honrichs over the same estate of Witow. It replaces that document only once the annulment takes effect.
The certificate records, 'ad No 2', the 50,000 Rthl pledged to the Invalids' Fund 'gemäß der darüber sub dato Berlin, den 28. Januar 1805. ausgestellten Urkunde'.
A covering rescript of the same day, transmitting an engrossment of the purchase contract confirmed under that date.
The confirmation names the purchase contract of 16 and 25 January 1805; document 4 is that contract, subscribed at Breslau on 16 January 1805.

The War and Domains Chamber returns the hereditary-lease contract submitted to it and declares the hereditary leasing of the lordship of Betsche to the town's burgesses wholly inadmissible. Document 18 is that contract.
Copied between the power of attorney and the contract. The consent allows the parcelling of the manor farm of Drzewce, a hundred Hufen of whose forest the contract lets.
Extends to three further owners the Emperor's decree of 5 June 1807 for Wybicki ('Wyrok N° Cesarza JW° Wybickiemu służący'), whose execution document 1 orders.

The resolution says her case 'do Nas przez N° Cesarza został odesłany' (was referred to us by the Emperor); the note on her petition to him says it was presented on 21 July by the Prince Director of War, by the Emperor's order.
'w Dekrecie Kommissyi Rządzącey wydanym dnia 21 Lipca a. c.': the commission's resolution of 21 July.
Triebenfeld encloses a copy of Hardenberg's resolution of 14 May 1814 ('lege ich in Abschrift hier bey'); document 3 is that copy.
Drafted beneath Triebenfeld's letter: 'auf Ihr Gesuch vom 25 v M.'
'die Vorstellung von 2 dM': Triebenfeld's petition of 2 March 1815.
Stein has passed on the letter the Prince wrote him on the 12th of last month; document 6 is that letter, with the direction for this reply written on it.
'Zuschrift vom 12ten d. M.': the Prince's letter of 12 May 1815.
'den Empfang Ihres ... Schreibens vom 12 v. M.': the Prince's letter of 12 May 1815.
The earlier draft is marked 'Cessat et vid. die anderweite Verfügung vom 6. Juny 1815'.
Sends Zerboni the Prince's two letters in the original, the one to Hardenberg of 12 May and the one to Stein of 12 April (document 6).
Zerboni reports on the order of 6 June 1815 and returns the two original letters.
'unterm 26ten April d. J. gerichtete Vorstellung': the widow von Brehmer's petition.
Returns the enclosures she sent on 25 July 1816.
'In Gemäßheit ... Schreibens vom 29sten April d. J.': the instruction to Schöler.
'le rapport ci-joint du Lieutenant du Royaume de Pologne': document 2 is that copy.
The ministry's reply to the envoy's note and the report sent with it ('la nôte et le mémoire'); the draft dates the note 20 February, the note itself is of 20 January.
'Le rapport ci-joint du Lieutenant': the copy of Prince Zajączek's report.
Sends Minister von Schuckmann a copy of the Russian envoy's note.
'Schreiben ... vom 13ten d. M. und dessen Beilagen'.
Weigel replies 'auf die hohe Eröffnung vom 22 v. M. No. 59607/938', the minister's letter of 22 September 1830.
The minister answers the papers Weigel sent 'przy swem podaniu daty 14 Oktobra 1830', with his letter of 14 October.
